units.source_text: 是夜源氏中将晋爵，由从三位升为正三位。

en.t: That night, Genji, the Middle Captain, was promoted in rank, rising from Junior Third Rank to Senior Third Rank.

units.source_text: 头中将也升为正四位下。

en.t: The Captain of the Left Palace Guards was also promoted to Senior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade.

units.source_text: 其他公卿，亦各得升官之庆，皆托源氏公子之福。

en.t: The other court nobles, too, each had the joy of receiving promotions, all thanks to the good fortune brought by Lord Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏公子能以妙技惊人目，以馀德悦人心，福慧双全，不知几生修得也。

en.t: Lord Genji could astonish people with his marvelous skill and gladden their hearts with the virtue that overflowed from him; blessed with both fortune and wisdom, one could not know through how many lives he had cultivated such gifts.
